description: This file contains data transfer object (DTO) definitions for order-related API interactions in a Kotlin frontend project, particularly designed for JSON serialization/deserialization with Moshi. It defines classes such as OrderDto, OrderItemDto, and related request objects used to communicate order data between frontend and backend.

classes.name: OrderItemDto
classes.description: DTO representing an individual item in an order, including product details and quantity.

classes.name: OrderDto
classes.description: DTO representing an entire order, including metadata such as ID, status, timestamps, total amount, and list of order items.

classes.name: OrderCreateItemRequestDto
classes.description: DTO for creating a new order item, specifying product ID and quantity.

classes.name: OrderCreateRequestDto
classes.description: DTO for creating a new order, including optional email and list of items.
